Hear what our customers say.
Over the past several years, we have been using SISA’s ProACT MDR services to meet PCI Compliance for 24/7 log monitoring. For our most recent certification, we decided to migrate the application to Google Cloud Platform’s Kubernetes environment from an AWS + local application setup to improve reliability. Based on our requirement to support GCP SISA ProACT, SISA’s team worked with our developers to build a new SIEM application to fit our specific needs. The ProACT tool’s custom alerting together with the MDR team’s prompt actions has significantly improved our threat detection and response capability.
Karl Cavanaugh
Lead Security Analyst, Club Prophet Software, LLC
A key differentiator for SISA is that their Core PFI’s are part of the FDR team, bringing extensive experience in identifying potential vulnerabilities across the attack surface. Working collaboratively with our analysts, the team has helped proactively prevent several potential breaches and threats.
Henry Itayi
Cyber Security Manager, NMB Bank Limited
SISA's team played a pivotal role in the ISO27001:2013 project certification's success. Their dedication and expertise were crucial, enhancing overall productivity through teamwork. SISA’s team's wealth of knowledge and willingness to go the extra mile made the project journey successful. The project served as a platform for invaluable learning opportunities. We truly appreciate their outstanding contribution and exceptional work ethic.
Claudia Borge
Information Security Manager, Accedo Technologies
SISA's consultants played a pivotal role in securing Ikontel's ISO 27001:2013 certification. The team’s inspiring leadership, strategic vision, dedication, technical expertise, and attention to detail ensured we successfully achieved this milestone and enhanced our organization's information security stature. Their exceptional professionalism and teamwork have set new standards for our organization, making them invaluable assets to our team, and paving the way for future successes.
Fazle Rasul
IT Manager, Ikontel
SISA’s team showed exceptional dedication and expertise for a successful ISO 27001:2022 transition. Our entire team is truly impressed by your seamless processes, and extraordinary client support. It reflects your high standard of excellence and customer-centric values.
Md Iqbal Karim
Lead Cybersecurity Specialist & Solution Architect, SSL Wireless
Our clients in Africa are satisfied with the SISA Radar, the data discovery tool, which helped to identify challenges and offered top-class compliance solutions like the PCI DSS, GDPR, CCPA, and others.
Stephen Oboh
CEO Nigeria & Africa, Ambassadors Cyber technology ltd
Safaricom, supported by SISA's expertise, successfully obtained PCIDSS certification, significantly enhancing its security infrastructure and setting a new benchmark in operational excellence.
Carolyne Luchiri
Sr. Manager (CISO Office), Safaricom
SISA Assistant's timely support significantly enhanced our team's efficiency and productivity in cybersecurity testing and compliance projects.
Naresh Patro
AVP, Paynext Pvt Ltd
SISA Assistant is an exceptional private platform for audits. Its user-friendly interface, swift operation, and attention to detail make it a game-changer in auditing. It makes navigating through tasks effortless ensuring efficient audits
Marouane Taouil
Analyst – SOC, S2M Morocco
We extend our sincere appreciation to the SISA team for their outstanding work. Payswiff has partnered with SISA since day one, beginning with our PCI PIN assessment, and we have been consistently pleased with our association. The team has been instrumental in guiding us through critical situations, and we deeply appreciate their expertise and support.
N.Saravana Krishnan
Information Security Manager - Payswiff
SISA has played a crucial role by offering valuable guidance through their systematic and professional approach to integrating security into our processes and systems. We deeply appreciate and acknowledge the efforts and support of the SISA team at all levels in securing PCI SLC recognition
Kalyankumar Asangi

SISA is a Leader in Cybersecurity Solutions for the Digital Payment Industry. As a Global Payment Forensic Investigator of the PCI Security Standards Council, we leverage forensics insights into preventive, detective, and corrective security solutions, protecting 1,000+ organizations across 40+ countries from evolving cyberthreats.
Our suite of solutions from AI-driven compliance, advanced security testing, agentic detection/ response and learner focused-training has been honored with prestigious awards, including from Financial Express, DSCI-NASSCOM and The Economic Times.
With commitment to innovation, and pioneering advancements in Quantum Security, Hardware Security, and Cybersecurity for AI, SISA is shaping the future of cybersecurity through cutting-edge forensics research.
